messages:
sarah: Putting together a 1-slide "goal snapshot" + a 24h micro-peer check process for the quarter. Want something folks can finish in under 3 mins. Feedback?

sarah: SNAPSHOT TEMPLATE (pasteable):
```
Team: [team]
Quarter: Q2 2026
Owner: [name]
North Star (1 line): [outcome]
Why it matters (1 line): [customer / biz outcome]
Top 3 KRs (metric + target) with confidence 0-10:
 - KR1: [metric target] (conf: 7)
 - KR2: [metric target] (conf: 5)
 - KR3: [metric target] (conf: 6)
Top actions (3) + est. effort (S/M/L):
 - A1 (M)
 - A2 (L)
 - A3 (S)
Main dependency / blocker: [who / what]
Primary signal to watch: [metric]
One-line ask to manager: [e.g., unblock / prioritize / hire]
Peer check (ping 3 peers; 3 one-line prompts):
 - Biggest customer impact?
 - What should I deprioritize?
 - Anything missing?
Quick self-review guide (for end-of-cycle):
 - For each KR: 1 line "what worked" + 1 line "evidence"
 - Finish with 1-line lesson + 1 clear ask
```

josh: Nice. Add an "est. effort" tag as you have and a very-short risk note for each KR (one word: infra / data / hiring).

elaine: Also include a one-line example per role (SWE / PM / ML infra) so people can copy. Keeps variance low.

mike: Rename "Top goal" -> "North Star" like Sarah did. Helps cross-team clarity.

josh: For peer check flow: DM 3 peers the snapshot + prompts, ask for one-liners within 24h. If no reply, escalate to your manager for input.

elaine: Micro-reply templates to make responses fast: "Prioritize KR1; drop A3", "Clarify KR2 -> revenue", "Targets look high; suggest -15%".

people-ops-bot: Goal snapshot template is live -> https://redwoodhq.internal/goals/snapshot (handbook updated). :bookmark_tabs:

sarah: I'll add three filled examples tonight (SWE, PM, ML infra). Planning a 5-min manager sync tomorrow to demo.

mike: For manager 60s coaching prompts:
 - "If this is going great in 90 days, what changed?"
 - "What's the biggest unknown?"
 - "One thing I can do this week to move the needle?"

elaine: Self-review pro-tip: keep evidence quantitative where possible. If not, include a customer quote or PR/issue link.

sarah: rollout checklist:
 - add examples (3 roles)
 - include est. effort + KR risk tag + confidence
 - add DM template for 24h peer check
 - wire into goal packet and handbook

josh: tiny ops: auto-create a DM template in Slack with the three prompts so it's one-click.

sarah: will wire that and post new thread with examples. thanks everyone! :tada:
